senses.gloss:
Plīhā-karṇa as an epithet of cattle in the yajurveda Saṃhitās probably denotes ‘having a spleen-shaped mark branded on the ear,’ not as Mahīdhara in his commentary on the Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā takes it, ‘having a disease called Plīhan in the ear.’
Foot notes Maitrāyaṇī Saṃhitā, iii. 13, 5 (cf. iv. 2, 9); Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xxiv. 24.
Loc. cit.
